policies.same_version: same business payload collapses; differing payload blocks publication
policies.delivery: earliest ingested_at retained for otherwise identical payload
policies.as_of: only rows ingested_at <= as_of are visible
policies.refunds: latest event revisions restate original order KST date; total <= gross
policies.schema: exact fields and types; unknown fields block; future evolution requires new version
policies.missing_mapping: block whole batch; preserve current; quarantine raw input
policies.coverage: missing or false source coverage makes partition incomplete; report unknown
policies.publication: one local flock writer; immutable artifacts; atomic CURRENT pointer
policies.backfill: full replacement of same scope/window; no as_of regression

metrics.attribution: synthetic single campaign per order; not causal attribution
metrics.spend_krw: latest cumulative snapshot_at, then latest revision; never sum snapshots
metrics.gross_sales_krw: sum latest visible order gross amount on original KST order date
metrics.refund_krw: sum latest visible refund events, restated on original KST order date
metrics.observed_roas: net_attributed_sales_krw / spend_krw; null if spend is zero
metrics.roas: observed_roas only if all source coverage complete; otherwise null
metrics.coverage: source assertion through UTC watermark; not independent proof of completeness
